title: Metals as reducing agents
caption: The more negative a metal's electrode potential, the more readily it gives up electrons: lithium and potassium are the strongest reducing agents, gold the weakest. This is the reactivity series, measured.
alt: A vertical scale of E° for metal ion/metal couples from Li⁺/Li at −3.04 V at the bottom to Au³⁺/Au at +1.50 V at the top.
description: Bottom: Li −3.04, K −2.93, Ca −2.87, Na −2.71, Mg −2.37 V: most reactive.
Top: Cu +0.34, Ag +0.80, Au +1.50 V: least reactive.
